verdict.rationale: Anrok documents a built-in AI assistant, AI Atlas, that answers sales-tax questions with visible reasoning, grounded in the seller's own transactions, registrations, filings and certificates. That is an in-product assistant, but the evidence only shows question-answering, not delegating actions or tasks. The Headless Tax 'hand it to your agents' line refers to external agents, not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence that the assistant executes tasks (e.g., filing, registration, certificate handling) on the user's behalf, in-depth docs on its capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
